title: Key West Christmas Cruise with Live Band and Drinks
includes: Two drinks included. Beer, wine, champagne for ages 21+. Non-alcoholic drinks also available.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Guests must check in at the ticket booth 30-45 minutes prior to the departure time for boarding passes
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us for a family-friendly holiday sail aboard Schooner America 2.0 decorated with festive Christmas lights! Sing along to your favorite Christmas music with our live band and celebrate the holidays and Christmas in Key West. Enjoy a festive hot cocoa and holiday treats as we glide along with water for a fun night in Key West. Our beautiful 105-foot Schooner America 2.0 in full holiday decor that's sure to get you into the Christmas spirit in Key West harbor.
